controls.gesture: HUD buttons only, no pinch recognizer
controls.ultrawide: Minimum >= max(viewport width,height)/1848, clamped .75..1, to preserve loaded-chunk coverage
controls.lod: Only noncolliding decorative world_decor flower nodes hidden below .99. Collectible flowers, trees, colliders and simulation untouched.

tests.touch: Synthetic native joystick hold plus camera tap, reset without move/lasso, same world wall contact at 100/75, existing touch loss cases re-run
limits: Camera changes do not fix previously reported long-session stall or Rodeo 20.

performance.environment: Godot 4.7.2, Linux llvmpipe Vulkan mobile renderer, 1280x720, V6 seed752026, 400 discovered chunks, OSD off during frame batches, OSD on for separate screenshot checks
performance.method: 150 frames per batch; 1x/0.75x/1x/0.75x at 4 sites after streaming/warmup. Separate 60-frame confirmation.
performance.interpretation: No consistent slowdown in sampled cases; small variations within observed noise. Draw calls are not literally identical: -3 to +7. This is not a universal zero-cost or phone-FPS guarantee. Active chunk counts can differ by route history, not zoom; same within each pair.
performance.osd: OSD snapshots use a 0.5s frame window; engine process monitor can retain a previous PNG-capture stall and is not the frame-batch mean.

future_equipment: docs/IDEAS_FUTURAS.md. Design proposal only, no economy or equipment implementation.
